eventChain: Ashan climbs the lighthouse cliff at dusk, golden glow surrounds.
He discovers an ancient iron gate etched with runes on the wall.
Ashan considers exploring a dark alley or staying atop the lighthouse.
Along the alley, the stone steps tremble and the gate opens into an underground passage.
At the lighthouse top, Ashan spots a mist‑shrouded cave glowing faintly in the distance.
Both paths lead to the base of an old warehouse, where a dusty wooden crate lies.
Ashan decides to open the crate with either the iron hammer or the keyhole.
Hitting the crate with the hammer, it opens to reveal a glowing rune stone.
Using the keyhole, the crate opens to expose a flickering rune stone and an ancient sword.
The rune stone illuminates an ancient prophecy, granting Ashan lighthouse guardian powers.
The ancient sword shines under moonlight, and Ashan embarks on a greater adventure.
